The FloPlast solvent weld weathering collar is a robust 110mm uPVC component engineered for dependable soil and vent pipe installations. This essential collar creates a secure seal around pipes, preventing water ingress and protecting structures from the elements. Utilising a reliable solvent weld fitting system, it ensures a permanent connection, vital for long-term drainage system integrity in both new construction and repair projects. Its durable black uPVC construction is an ideal choice for secure external pipework in various building applications.
